data.description:
This is additional evidence for tracker finding #83

Finding #83 documents the first Harvard International Office source/Git-file probe wave at 17:33:47–17:34:12 UTC on June 21, 2026. A broader read-only review of the same Arquivo.pt HIO corpus identifies two later automated enumeration waves at approximately 18:56 and 19:32 UTC, plus administrative and directory checks at 19:04.

Across the complete 17:33:47–19:32:30 UTC sequence, I count 72 security-relevant captured requests over 37 distinct normalized paths. The later requests expand beyond the paths already described in finding #83 to include:

- `HIOAjax.php.bak` and repeated `.phps` / `~` variants;
- guessed `data.csv`, `data.json`, `data.xlsx`, `statistics.json`, `statistics.xlsx`, and `import.xlsx` files;
- inferred sibling-module paths under `hio_excel_import`, including `.info`, `.install`, `.module`, `.inc`, PHP, backup, and data-file guesses;
- `/admin/config/search/xmlsitemap`; and
- directory checks for `/sites/default/files/` and `/sites/default/files/HIOFiles/`.

Most later requests carry fresh random decimal `cb=` parameters, and much of the enumeration set is repeated at 19:32 with new values. This supports systematic automated reconnaissance rather than ordinary statistics-page use.

All 72 security-relevant captures failed safely: 70 returned HTTP 404 and two returned HTTP 403. Representative archived responses show Harvard-branded “Page not found,” “Access denied,” or generic 403 pages. No source code, Git metadata, private data, administrative access, authentication bypass, or modification is demonstrated.

The surrounding corpus includes 1,931 unique decoded browser programs targeting HIO, mostly looping `XMLHttpRequest` and canvas/data-return programs. This is strong agent-like workflow context, but the sensitive path strings do not appear in those decoded programs, and Arquivo does not expose a source-IP, session, author, or model join. Attribution of the probes to the same agent workflow therefore remains behavioral and moderate-confidence. AI provider remains Unknown.

This update changes the completeness and scale of the reconnaissance timeline, not the security-impact conclusion in finding #83.
data.summary: Update to #83: later HIO probes bring the June 21 total to 72 requests across 37 paths; all failed (403/404).
